Mama was in the kitchen. She made adobo for lunch. The smell came out of the door and down the road. My brother ran in and said, "I am so hungry!" Mama laughed. "Wash your hands first," she said. We sat at the table with Tatay and Lolo. Mama put the rice in a big bowl. We ate and talked about the day. After lunch, I helped Mama wash the plates. She gave me a hug and said, "Salamat, anak." It was a good day at home.
